action_items: No backend test file was added: Upload/Analysis/Compliance-Result screens are frontend localStorage MOCKS per seed_facts, with no API-bearing behavior to cover per the backend-test rule.

checks.criterion: Redesigned Scan a Product upload preserves the existing upload flow
checks.name: scan-upload-redesign-flow
checks.evidence: upload-title shows 'Scan a Product'; a .txt file triggered the existing 'Unsupported file' toast with no selected-file-name; a PNG produced package-image-preview + upload-success-state; replace swapped to a PDF (package-pdf-preview); optional metadata fields accepted input; remove cleared back to upload-dropzone-title; re-adding a JPG and clicking Analyze Product routed to analysis-page.

checks.criterion: Analysis screen presents exactly five staged states without fake progress
checks.name: analysis-five-stage-lifecycle
checks.evidence: analysis-step-title-0..4 matched Image Received/OCR Extraction/Declaration Detection/Compliance Checking/Report Preparation exactly (analysis-step-5 absent); no '% complete' text, no [role=progressbar], no analysis-progress-bar element found; flow auto-routed to compliance-result-page showing the newly created product name.

checks.criterion: Overall returned statuses use the new plain-language mapping
checks.name: overall-status-plain-language-mapping
checks.evidence: ANL-2026-001 (compliant) rendered result-overall-label 'COMPLIANT'; ANL-2026-002 (non_compliant) rendered 'POTENTIAL VIOLATION' with rose-toned result-overall-status; ANL-2026-003 (review_required) rendered 'REQUIRES REVIEW' with amber-toned result-overall-status.

checks.criterion: Compliance Screening Result is evidence-first and data-driven
checks.name: compliance-result-evidence-first
checks.evidence: result-title 'Compliance Screening Result', result-analysis-date contained ANL-2026-001, summary counters (passed/warning/failed/not-detected) visible, result-score-value showed the seeded 98, Product Evidence + Detected Declarations panels rendered check-row-manufacturer and check-value-mrp='₹280.00 (Incl. of all taxes)' straight from seed data.

checks.criterion: Warnings and potential violations expose actionable returned details
checks.name: warnings-violations-actionable-details
checks.evidence: Expanding check-details-button-mrp/date on ANL-2026-002 revealed Detected/Why/Recommended text matching seeded reason and recommendation strings; result-violation-mrp-format row showed detected '₹450' and its recommendation; View Details navigated to violation-details-page with matching violation-detected-information and violation-recommendation.

checks.criterion: Image highlighting uses only returned coordinates
checks.name: image-highlight-returned-coordinates
checks.evidence: On ANL-2026-002, mrp-format (has location) auto-showed result-image-highlight and a result-violation-focus-mrp-format button; consumer-care-missing (location: null) had no focus button on the result page and no violation-image-highlight element on its own violation-details-page.

checks.criterion: Existing reports and navigation remain functional
checks.name: reports-navigation-existing-flows
checks.evidence: Generate Report opened reports-page pre-selected to ANL-2026-002; report-violation-mrp-format navigated to the correct violation-details-page; New screening returned to upload-page; sidebar Dashboard/Settings links routed correctly; sidebar-logout-button returned to login-form.

checks.criterion: Redesigned screens remain consistent and responsive
checks.name: redesigned-screens-responsive-theme-consistency
checks.evidence: At 390x844, Upload and Compliance Result pages had scrollWidth-clientWidth <= 1px in both light and dark (html.dark toggled via header-theme-toggle) states across all four captured screenshots.
